x1 = valmax(x0, size) - max size.

x6 = rbind(canvas, x5) -> canvas(value, (1, x1))? Wait rbind(canvas, x5) fixes rightmost argument, so canvas(value, dimensions) becomes lambda value: canvas(value, (1,x1)). Actually rbind returns lambda x: function(x, fixed), so function = canvas, fixed = (1,x1). So x6(color) = canvas(color, (1, x1)) which is grid of 1 row, x1 columns.

x7 = apply(x6, x4) - list of single-row grids, each 1 x x1.

x8 = merge(x7) - merge concatenates. For tuples, type(containers)(e for c in containers for e in c). containers is tuple of 1-row grids. Each c is a grid (tuple of rows), each e is a row (tuple). So merge gives tuple of rows: a grid with len(x4) rows and x1 columns.

x9 = dmirror(x8) - transpose. So output becomes x1 rows and len(x4) columns.

So output: height = x1 (max size), width = number of largest shapes. Each column j is the color of j-th largest shape (left to right), appearing x1 times.

So output is vertical lines of length = size of shape, one per largest shape.
